issues.evidence: Compilation failed with: “/root/Tokenizer.scala:323: error: value value overrides nothing final case class TokenMonad[+A](override val value: Option[A]) ...”
issues.cause: TokenMonad attempted to override a member (value) without actually extending a superclass/trait that defines it; the initial design didn’t align the intended inheritance between TokenFunctor and TokenMonad.

issues.evidence: Compilation failed with: “error: `override` modifier required to override concrete member: def map... (defined in class TokenFunctor)” and similarly for getOrElse.
issues.cause: After changing TokenMonad to extend TokenFunctor, methods with the same signatures were redefining concrete superclass methods but were not marked with override, which Scala requires.

issues.evidence: Compilation failed with: “could not optimize @tailrec annotated method loop: it contains a recursive call not in tail position” in JsonTokenizer.tokenizePath.
issues.cause: The recursive call was inside Option.flatMap, which prevents it from being in tail position; the method cannot satisfy @tailrec’s constraints.

outcome_rationale: The final compilation succeeded (“scalac /root/Tokenizer.scala” with exit code 0 at turn 13) and the produced Scala file includes the required named classes/functions per the trace, so the translation is likely completed successfully despite earlier compile-time missteps.
